name: Armix of the Scrapped Past
text:
Armix gets +1/+1 for each artifact and creature card in your graveyard with an activated ability.
During your turn, you may activate activated abilities of artifact and creature cards in your graveyard as though they were on the battlefield. (Tap them in your graveyard.)

name: Can’t Back Down
text: Each nontoken creature you control gains persist until end of turn, then destroy all creatures. (When it dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner’s control with a -1/-1 counter on it.)
flavorText: In Shadowmoor, the darkest emotions are the only way to endure the night.

name: Confuse
text: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card, then puts a Confusion card into their hand. (Confusion is a colorless sorcery card with no mana cost that has cycling {2}.)

name: Inkredible Idea
text: Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle. Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. It gains “Whenever this creature dies, put the exiled card into your hand.”
flavorText: “Writer’s block? Naa, I prefer writer’s attack.”

name: Inverted Pathogenesis
text:
When this enchantment enters, create three 1/1 green Swamp Dryad land creature tokens. (They’re affected by summoning sickness.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature.
flavorText: “Dawnsire, Log 122: Planet Adagia breaks under the sickness we caused. Its twisted, dying life is filled with retribution, and I sense something far worse has been awakened.”

name: Pain is the Greatest Teacher
text:
Whenever you lose life, create that many Blood tokens. Then, if you lost 3 or more life, learn. (You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.)
{1}, Sacrifice a Blood: You gain 1 life.

name: Rat Pack
text:
This creature’s power and toughness are each equal to the number of booster packs you’ve opened this event.
{2}{B}, Discard a card: Open a sealed Magic booster pack, reveal the cards, and put one of them into your hand. (Remove that card from your deck before beginning a new game.)

name: Table of Costly Greatness
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a Dark Confidant token. (It’s a {1}{B} 2/1 Human Wizard creature with “At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. You lose life equal to its mana value.”)
{T}, Tap five untapped Wizards you control: Target opponent loses 10 life and you gain 10 life.
